result.instructions: Tools for Recurly, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Recurly data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run recurly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run recurly_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run recurly_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. recurly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: recurly_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List customer accounts on the site. Supports cursor pagination and filtering. Recurly: GET /accounts.

sort.description: Field to order by. Default created_at.

begin_time.description: ISO 8601 lower bound (inclusive) for the `sort` field, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 upper bound (exclusive) for the `sort` field.

subscriber.description: If true, only accounts with a subscription; if false, only without.

tools.name: recurly_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Fetch one account by its id (no prefix, e.g. e28zov4fw0v2) or by your own code prefixed with `code-` (e.g. code-bob). Recurly: GET /accounts/{account_id}.

account_id.description: Account id (no prefix) or "code-<your account code>".

tools.name: recurly_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions across the site, optionally scoped to one account and/or filtered by state. Provide `account_id` to use GET /accounts/{account_id}/subscriptions; otherwise GET /subscriptions.

account_id.description: Optional: scope to one account. Id (no prefix) or "code-<code>".

sort.description: Field to order by. Default created_at.

begin_time.description: ISO 8601 lower bound (inclusive) for the `sort` field, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 upper bound (exclusive) for the `sort` field.

tools.name: recurly_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Fetch one subscription by its id (no prefix) or by uuid prefixed with `uuid-`. Recurly: GET /subscriptions/{subscription_id}.

tools.name: recurly_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices across the site, or for one account when `account_id` is given (GET /accounts/{account_id}/invoices). Recurly: GET /invoices.

account_id.description: Optional: scope to one account. Id (no prefix) or "code-<code>".

sort.description: Field to order by. Default created_at.

begin_time.description: ISO 8601 lower bound (inclusive) for the `sort` field, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 upper bound (exclusive) for the `sort` field.

tools.name: recurly_list_plans
tools.title: List plans
tools.description: List the site's subscription plans, optionally filtered by state. Recurly: GET /plans.

sort.description: Field to order by. Default created_at.

begin_time.description: ISO 8601 lower bound (inclusive) for the `sort` field, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 upper bound (exclusive) for the `sort` field.

tools.name: recurly_cancel_subscription
tools.title: Cancel subscription (WRITE — changes billing)
tools.description: Cancel a subscription. By default it stays active until the end of the current term (`term_end`); pass timeframe `bill_date` to cancel effective the next bill date. This changes billing state. Recurly: PUT /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel.

timeframe.description: When cancellation takes effect. Default term_end (end of current term).

tools.name: recurly_pause_subscription
tools.title: Pause subscription (WRITE — changes billing)
tools.description: Pause a subscription for a number of upcoming billing cycles. Set `remaining_pause_cycles` to 0 to resume/cancel an existing pause. This changes billing state. Recurly: PUT /subscriptions/{subscription_id}/pause.

remaining_pause_cycles.description: Number of billing cycles to pause. 0 resumes/cancels a scheduled pause.
